name: Account hacked, playlists inaccessible
description: Customer reports account was hacked and cannot recover playlists.

name: Unexpected logout and subscription access issues
description: Customers report being logged out automatically or unable to access paid subscriptions after login.

name: Login failures and authentication errors
description: Customers cannot log in due to error messages, connection issues, or password rejection.

name: Core features locked behind Premium paywall
description: Customers report most app features now require Premium, including song selection and skip limits.

name: Subscription costs too high
description: Customers complain about expensive pricing for music and replay features.

name: Premium subscription purchase fails
description: Customers cannot complete Premium subscription purchases due to blank pages or connection errors.

name: Song lyrics fail to load
description: Customers report lyrics not displaying or loading for songs in playlists.

name: Missing songs and limited artist catalog
description: Customers report favorite songs unavailable, limited content for smaller artists and specific genres.

name: Unwanted songs and repetitive recommendations
description: Customers report playlists play random songs, recommendations ignore settings, and DJs repeat songs.

name: Downloads stuck in progress
description: Customer reports downloads remain stuck in background without completing.

name: Downloaded songs disappear unexpectedly
description: Customer reports downloaded content vanishes when out of data range.

name: Offline mode not working
description: Customers report offline functionality and downloads not functioning.

name: Offline storage issues and data waste
description: Customers report offline mode useless and storage management failures deleting content.

name: General app dissatisfaction and poor quality
description: Customers express overall dissatisfaction with app quality and company priorities.

name: Unrelated complaints and protest uninstalls
description: Customers report personal objections or protest-based app uninstallation.

name: Poor audio quality and noise
description: Customer reports audio quality is poor with unpleasant noise.

name: False no internet connection errors
description: Customers report app claims no internet despite working connection on other apps.

name: App crashes and won't open
description: Customers report app crashing, black screens, or failing to open after updates.

name: Device casting and connection problems
description: Customers report difficulty connecting to gaming consoles, PCs, and other devices.

name: Podcast playback lagging
description: Customer reports Premium podcasts experience lag during playback.

name: Playback stops or won't play songs
description: Customers report music stops randomly, songs don't play, or skipping disabled after updates.

name: Rude and unhelpful customer support
description: Customer reports support staff were rude and unhelpful.

name: Excessive ads in free tier
description: Customers report too many ads playing frequently throughout the app.

name: Missing features and confusing navigation
description: Customers report missing features, unclear settings, and automatic playback they cannot disable.

name: Cannot add songs to queue
description: Customer reports inability to add songs to queue after update.

name: Wrong songs play and limited skip controls
description: Customers report clicking songs plays different tracks and skip limits restrict playback control.

name: New UI redesign less user-friendly
description: Customers report recent updates made navigation harder and removed previously loved features.
